prayerExcerpt.en-US: "To live in great simplicity," said St. Pachomius, "and in a wise ignorance, is exceeding wise."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Viver em grande simplicidade", disse São Pacômio, "e numa sábia ignorância, é sumamente sábio."

meta.face: A Copt of the Thebaid of about fifty-five, broad-shouldered like the soldier he once was, with a deep-brown, sun-darkened complexion and a LONG, STRAIGHT-SIDED face under a BROAD, HIGH, smooth BALD dome — a STRAIGHT, broad nose with a LOW, FLAT bridge and WIDE, flared nostrils, LARGE, wide-open, dark ALMOND eyes set WIDE apart and rimmed with thick black lashes, like a Fayum portrait's, under straight, thick black-and-grey brows; flat cheeks; FULL, thick lips; a grey-streaked black beard to mid-breast, parted into FIVE narrow, separate POINTS; the gaze direct and vigilant, toward us.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia) describes 'Saint Pachomius, an old man, bald, with a beard divided into five points', with the angel before him; Wikipedia's lead image, a modern Coptic icon, shows him white-bearded in a dark monastic habit, an angel bringing a tablet. The book tells a heathen conscript of twenty-one, baptized after the kindness of Christians on the Nile, the disciple of Palemon, and the monastery at Tabenna for which an angel gave him a rule; its engraving shows a hooded monk writing at a rock while an angel stands by with a book. The five-pointed beard and the bald head follow the Hermeneia; the long, straight-sided face with the flat, broad nose and the large almond eyes is our choice, for a Copt of Upper Egypt (Wikipedia: born in the Thebaid, c. 292–348).
